const requestIdleCallbackPolyfill = (callback) => {
  const timeout = 0;
  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
    callback({
      didTimeout: true,
      // Always indicate timeout for the polyfill
      timeRemaining: () => 50

  }, timeout);
  return timeoutId;
};
